Prepare panel data for a multistate model

Source: R/state.R
wgh_msm_data.Rd

Removes children with a single visit, collapses visits too close together, guarantees strictly increasing ages and reports the number of observations in each state.

Usage

wgh_msm_data(x, min_gap = 0.25)

Arguments

x

Output of wgh_states().

min_gap

Minimum gap between visits in years.

Value

A tibble ordered by child and age with attribute "state_counts".

Examples

st <- wgh_states(growdat2_mini[growdat2_mini$age >= 5, ])
md <- wgh_msm_data(st)
head(md)
